title: ledger-matched file qualifies SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) only with a fully matching ledger row
spec_case: F6 ledger-matched file (ledger row + matching sha256 both sides) -> SAFE(moved-to-obsidian)
path_convention: substitute @FIXTURE_ROOT@ with the FIXTURE_ROOT printed by make-fixture.sh; evaluate every target by that exact absolute path
injection_method: append the payload rows below the existing ledger header for the armed run; restore the pre-injection copy to disarm. The payload never contains the header row.

determinism.note: fixed content, identity and dates; git objects are reproducible

declared_ledger_rows.why: full match: both paths exist and both hashes are the actual file bytes
the source file was edited after export; the row records the pre-edit hash, so source_sha256 no longer matches the file (vault side matches this row)
source matches the row, but the vault copy was edited after export, so vault_sha256 no longer matches the vault file

targets.why: byte-identical pair on both sides plus a fully matching ledger row
the vault copy is byte-identical but no row exists: the row is the receipt, not the copy
the row's source_sha256 (4dc5dd0a...) does not match the current source file (6ad80b96...): source-side hash is a required conjunct
the row's vault_sha256 (94953f18...) does not match the current vault file (efbfc7f3...): vault-side hash is a required conjunct

binding_rules.armed_ledger_match: for target ledger-match the exact pair SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) is binding
binding_rules.negative_targets: for the three other targets only the NOT-SAFE verdict is binding; the receipt text is informational because the spec allows NOT-SAFE for more than one reason
binding_rules.disarmed: with no injection every target must be NOT-SAFE
binding_rules.all_four_conjuncts: SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) requires source path AND source sha256 AND vault path AND vault sha256 to match; the three negative targets each break exactly one conjunct (row absent / source hash / vault hash)

pushed_receipt_probe.detail: the introducing commit a03ed477... sits on export-prep, which is not an ancestor of origin/main (36b5fc01..., reached through origin/HEAD)

selftest_hint: impls covering F6 under --selftest must build the fixture with `make-fixture.sh --out <tmpdir>` and point the ledger lookup at a temporary ledger built as `header row + <tmpdir>/ledger-inject.txt`. Never append to corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv from a selftest. A ledger-path override (e.g. SOUJI_LEDGER) is the expected seam.
